preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000.
Each segment cost A, B, C, D, E, F, G is between 1 and 50.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output, int) for output in outputs)
all(0 <= output <= sum([A, B, C, D, E, F, G]) * 7 for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output is a non-negative integer not exceeding the maximum possible cost to light up all segments.
The number of outputs matches the number of test cases T.
